zh-CN.title: 奖励品质一眼可见
items: 升级页面用独立颜色、纹理和标记区分五种奖励品质
聊天背景、气泡与头像框现在直接展示各自品质
菜单成长入口会随本级最高品质呈现对应视觉

en.title: Reward rarity at a glance
items: Level-up rewards now use distinct colors, textures, and markers for all five rarities
Backgrounds, bubbles, and avatar frames show their rarity directly
The menu growth entry reflects the highest rarity unlocked at the current level
